The '''Deluge Device''' was a large construct that was built by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] on the plateau [[Final Rest]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]]. The Device resembled a [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|vaporator]] and it served as the centerpiece of the [[Deluge Experiment]], an effort by the CSA to alter the atmosphere of Nyriaan.
